params.command: $ErrorActionPreference='Stop'; $repo='C:\Users\Xxkan\mhw-mods-work-canonical'; if(!(Test-Path (Join-Path $repo '.git'))){ throw "repo missing: $repo" }; git -C $repo fetch origin '+refs/heads/*:refs/remotes/origin/*' --prune | Out-Host; $deleted=@(); $kept=@(); $failed=@(); $refs = git -C $repo for-each-ref '--format=%(refname:strip=3)' refs/remotes/origin/ | Where-Object { $_ -and $_ -ne 'main' -and $_ -ne 'heaven-bridge' -and $_ -ne 'HEAD' } | Sort-Object; foreach($b in $refs){ git -C $repo fetch origin "refs/heads/$b:refs/remotes/origin/$b" --force 2>$null | Out-Null; if($LASTEXITCODE -ne 0){ $kept += [pscustomobject]@{branch=$b;reason='fetch-failed-or-absent'}; continue }; $tip=(git -C $repo rev-parse "refs/remotes/origin/$b").Trim(); $plus = @(git -C $repo cherry origin/main "origin/$b" 2>$null | Where-Object { $_ -like '+*' }); if($LASTEXITCODE -ne 0){ $kept += [pscustomobject]@{branch=$b;reason='cherry-check-failed';sha=$tip}; continue }; if($plus.Count -gt 0){ $kept += [pscustomobject]@{branch=$b;reason=('unique-patches:'+ $plus.Count);sha=$tip}; continue }; git -C $repo fetch origin "refs/heads/$b:refs/remotes/origin/$b" --force 2>$null | Out-Null; if($LASTEXITCODE -ne 0){ $kept += [pscustomobject]@{branch=$b;reason='disappeared-before-delete'}; continue }; $tip2=(git -C $repo rev-parse "refs/remotes/origin/$b").Trim(); if($tip2 -ne $tip){ $kept += [pscustomobject]@{branch=$b;reason='moved-during-audit';before=$tip;after=$tip2}; continue }; git -C $repo push origin --delete -- $b 2>&1 | Out-String | ForEach-Object { $pushOut=$_ }; if($LASTEXITCODE -eq 0){ $deleted += [pscustomobject]@{branch=$b;sha=$tip;reason='no-patch-unique-commits'} } else { $failed += [pscustomobject]@{branch=$b;sha=$tip;reason='delete-failed';output=$pushOut.Trim()} } }; git -C $repo fetch origin '+refs/heads/*:refs/remotes/origin/*' --prune | Out-Host; $remaining=@(git -C $repo for-each-ref '--format=%(refname:strip=3)' refs/remotes/origin/ | Where-Object { $_ -and $_ -ne 'main' -and $_ -ne 'heaven-bridge' -and $_ -ne 'HEAD' } | Sort-Object); [pscustomobject]@{main=(git -C $repo rev-parse origin/main).Trim();deleted=$deleted;kept=$kept;failed=$failed;disposable_remaining_count=$remaining.Count;remaining=$remaining}|ConvertTo-Json -Depth 6
